reviews.author: Cameron Clough
reviews.excerpt: I recently bought my engagement ring here, and it was a fantastic experience. Right from the start, Nick and his team were very knowledgeable and helped me decide on the best design for my girlfriend.
reviews.fullText: I recently bought my engagement ring here, and it was a fantastic experience. Right from the start, Nick and his team were very knowledgeable and helped me decide on the best design for my girlfriend. When we visited the shop together, the team (Thuy and Vy I think) were incredibly attentive and kind which helped with her decision making as she wasn't exactly sure what she wanted. Contacting Nick with questions was easy, and he always provided honest advice, which is exactly the trust and comfort you need when making such an important purchase. Nick went off to source a stone that met our exact specifications, and the 3D print he created afterward was very helpful for visualising sizing. My girlfriend (now fiancée!) absolutely loves the ring, and it turned out perfect. I would definitely recommend Aurora to anyone ring shopping.

reviews.author: Cuong Tran
reviews.excerpt: Honestly, I cannot thank the team at Aurora enough. Before choosing them, I spent a long time researching and contacting many jewellers about my custom engagement ring design.
reviews.fullText:
Honestly, I cannot thank the team at Aurora enough. Before choosing them, I spent a long time researching and contacting many jewellers about my custom engagement ring design. Every single one of them either refused or said it could not be done, except Aurora. They were the only jewellers willing and able to bring my vision to life, and from the very beginning they treated my design with genuine care.They supported me through every stage of the process, from the first enquiry to the final collection.

They were patient with all my questions, incredibly helpful with their advice, and always willing to accommodate the changes we requested. What made the experience even more special was when they told me that this would be the only ring of this style they would ever create, making it truly unique.I am so glad I chose them. Their craftsmanship, professionalism, and kindness made the entire journey unforgettable. I fully recommend Aurora to anyone looking for bespoke jewellery, and I will definitely be returning to have more pieces made in the future.

Also their dog Bear was a really good sales dog. Greeted us with a smile and gave us loads of cuddles!

reviews.author: Deniz Mc
reviews.excerpt: I contacted Aurora to have a ring made after failing to find anything with the design I was after, and I couldn’t be happier with how it turned out. Working with Nick at Aurora to design and bring the ring to life was a great experience.
reviews.fullText:
I contacted Aurora to have a ring made after failing to find anything with the design I was after, and I couldn’t be happier with how it turned out. Working with Nick at Aurora to design and bring the ring to life was a great experience.

Every question I had was answered and Nick provided his expertise on diamonds, clarity, sizing, and metal types. His recommendations were thoughtful and genuinely tailored to what I wanted not just what was easiest to sell.

Being able to design the ring was a highlight of the experience. Nick provided honest feedback on whether the designs were practical, flagging any concerns around stability and strength before anything was committed to. That kind of input was invaluable and gave me the confidence that the final piece would look beautiful and be built to last.

When the first version of the engagement ring was completed, Nick personally reached out to let me know he wasn’t fully satisfied with it and wanted to remake it to a higher standard. That itself showed how much Aurora cares about craft and customers.

My now fiancé absolutely loves the ring and can’t stop staring it, all our close family and friends are so impressed with the design.

If you are looking to have your ring made I couldn’t recommend Nick and the team at Aurora enough, they are transparent and invested in getting it right.

We’re already looking to get wedding bands made and couldn’t be more excited!

reviews.author: The Wandering Daimon
reviews.excerpt: Incredible, just incredible! Both Thuy and Nick are really incredible, warm, and amazing people. From the get-go, Nick explained and educated me about what I should look for and understand before buying a natural diamond.
reviews.fullText:
Incredible, just incredible!

Both Thuy and Nick are really incredible, warm, and amazing people.

From the get-go, Nick explained and educated me about what I should look for and understand before buying a natural diamond. I was in the market for a natural diamond engagement ring. And believe me, I talked to MANY jewelers and companies in Vietnam. None were able to make me feel the trust, the helpfulness, and the expertise, like Aurora.

Nick wasn't even pushing me to buy anything. Heck, he offered to help me determine if a stone I want is worth or not, based on its clarity, cut, and color; and yes, that's whether I buy from Aurora or not!

Nick and Thuy took the time to carefully figure out what I want, and designs I like, and produced both a 3D model AND 3D print of a fairly delicate ring design I sent to them. They refined and refined, after each round of feedback from me (not because their work was anything short of spectacular, but because I am very picky). Then they even produced a silver version with moissanite for me to be able to visualize how the final ring would look like. You can't get this kind of service, attention to detail, friendliness, and warmth from ANYWHERE ELSE.

They never push for what they have in inventory either. After I picked what stone I'd like, they personally sourced the stone for me straight from cutters.

It was an incredible experience, and I will be back for more (not more engagement rings, of cos :P)!

reviews.author: Jade Nguyen
reviews.excerpt: Trải nghiệm thiết kế nhẫn cưới trong mơ – Cực kỳ hài lòng! Vợ chồng mình vừa nhận được cặp nhẫn cưới và nhẫn cầu hôn thiết kế riêng (custom), thực sự phải viết feedback ngay vì quá ưng ý.
reviews.fullText:
Trải nghiệm thiết kế nhẫn cưới trong mơ – Cực kỳ hài lòng!
Vợ chồng mình vừa nhận được cặp nhẫn cưới và nhẫn cầu hôn thiết kế riêng (custom), thực sự phải viết feedback ngay vì quá ưng ý. Ban đầu, hôn phu của mình đặt làm nhẫn cầu hôn và được đội ngũ hướng dẫn cực kỳ tận tâm. Điểm mình thích nhất là shop có gửi bản in 3D để khách xem trước, khi nào thật sự ưng bụng thì mới tiến hành chế tác và báo giá chính thức.
Vì quá ấn tượng với mẫu nhẫn cầu hôn, tụi mình quyết định đặt luôn cặp nhẫn cưới tại đây. Quy trình vẫn chuyên nghiệp như cũ, tỉ mỉ trong từng khâu. Từ lúc đặt đến khi nhận nhẫn mất khoảng 6 tuần, nhưng sự chờ đợi là hoàn toàn xứng đáng. Nhẫn cầm trên tay đẹp xuất sắc, từng chi tiết nhỏ đều được chăm chút tinh xảo, đúng chuẩn gu mà tụi mình mong muốn.
Cảm ơn anh Nick, chị Thủy, chị Ivy cùng cả team chế tác đã dành tâm huyết cho sản phẩm của tụi mình. Một địa chỉ cực kỳ uy tín cho các cặp đôi. Highly recommend!

The Wedding Rings of Our Dreams – Absolutely Satisfied!
My husband and I just received our custom-designed engagement and wedding rings, and I just had to write a review immediately because we are so thrilled. Initially, my fiancé ordered a custom engagement ring and was guided so heartfully by the team. What I loved most was that the shop sent a 3D-printed prototype for us to check. They only started the actual crafting and gave the official quote once we were 100% happy with the model.
Since we were so impressed with the engagement ring, we decided to order our wedding bands here as well. The process was just as professional and meticulous as the first time. It took about 6 weeks from ordering to having the rings in our hands, but the wait was absolutely worth it. The rings are stunning, with every tiny detail crafted to perfection, matching our personal style exactly.
A huge thank you to Mr. Nick, Mrs. Thuy, Mrs. Ivy, and the entire production team for putting so much heart into our rings. This is a highly reputable place for couples. Highly recommend!

I reached out a few months ago to see if they could custom-make a ring with an old mine-cut center stone, as that was what I had my heart set on. I'm so ecstatic with how it turned out. I would definitely recommend them if you're considering a custom jeweler in Vietnam for your engagement ring. The whole process was very easy.

reviews.author: Felix Matin
reviews.excerpt: After searching for the perfect engagement ring across Singapore, Ho Chi Minh City, and Hanoi, we kept running into the same frustration — vague, ambiguous pricing and no real way to compare options.
reviews.fullText:
After searching for the perfect engagement ring across Singapore, Ho Chi Minh City, and Hanoi, we kept running into the same frustration — vague, ambiguous pricing and no real way to compare options. That all changed when we discovered Aurora Saigon.

Their website's ring builder is simply outstanding. A full selection of settings and diamonds, all with completely transparent pricing. As someone unfamiliar with the market, this was a game-changer and genuinely unique compared to every other jeweler we visited.

We booked an appointment at their showroom in Thao Dien Square — a charming, cozy little enclave — and were immediately impressed. Ivy and the team were fantastic, walking us through the rings and diamonds with patience and expertise. The showroom itself is beautiful and the quality of the products is excellent.

We knew exactly what we wanted and placed our order on the spot. Communication throughout was clear and straightforward, and the service was second to none.

We will absolutely be returning to Aurora Saigon for future custom jewelry. If you want a jeweler with zero nonsense, zero hidden costs, and 100% transparency — look no further.

reviews.excerpt: We had an incredible experience with Aurora Jewelers while creating a custom engagement ring. From the very beginning, Nick and Thuy truly took the time to understand exactly what we wanted.
reviews.fullText:
We had an incredible experience with Aurora Jewelers while creating a custom engagement ring. From the very beginning, Nick and Thuy truly took the time to understand exactly what we wanted. They listened carefully to our ideas and then presented several thoughtfully designed options, including detailed 3D-printed samples, which made it so much easier to visualize and refine the final design.

Their knowledge of current trends and the jewelry industry was evident throughout the process. They offered expert guidance while still respecting our personal style and preferences, helping us create something that felt completely individualized and meaningful - especially in finding a way to incorporate our fur baby into the design!

The turnaround time from initial concept to finished ring was very reasonable, especially considering the level of detail and craftsmanship involved. The final product was absolutely beautiful—intricate, elegant, and even better than we imagined. We couldn’t be happier and highly recommend Aurora Jewelers for anyone looking for a truly custom piece.

Ce que j’ai particulièrement apprécié, c’est qu’il n’a jamais poussé à la consommation : il a même proposé des options en dessous de mon budget. Son seul objectif était que la bague soit parfaite pour moi et ma conjointe.

Un service fiable, humain et d’une qualité remarquable : je recommande les yeux fermés !

We had my engagement ring custom-made at this bespoke jewelry store located in Thao Dien, and it was a truly wonderful experience. Thuy and Nick were extremely professional, attentive to our wishes, and very responsive throughout the entire process.

The custom design journey was clear and well-structured, consisting of three key stages: a 3D digital model, a silver prototype to try on and make adjustments, and finally the finished ring in the chosen materials. This thoughtful process ensured that every detail was just right and that we felt confident and involved at each step.

The final result was exactly what we had hoped for—beautifully crafted and perfectly tailored to our expectations. Their craftsmanship and personal approach really made a difference. We highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a unique, custom-made piece of jewelry !

Honestly where do I start. The entire experience from start to finish has been a breeze. I first approached Nick via email as I live half way across the world. Buying something as valuable as an engagement ring is quite daunting. Especially if it’s from someone you have never met in person. But Nick answered all my stupid questions in a prompt manner, which is helpful with time zones being a factor. When I provided him with my requirements for a ring, he gave me a price expectation. My hopes and dreams were crushed lol. But Nick said not to not give up. He hustled to source high quality materials so that it can fit my budget. I requested for him to use lab grown gems to keep costs low but he absolutely did not have a bar of it and made it work. It is very reassuring that the business is more stressed about making the perfect ring rather than just seeing you as a transaction. The final result is absolutely stunning and my fiancée is blown away. After the proposal I let her read the email chain. In her own words.
“Wow, Nick is awn!!!!”
Thank you Nick and team Aurora!

I had an absolutely amazing experience working with Aurora Saigon to create my custom ring! From start to finish, Nick and his team went above and beyond to bring my vision to life. I wanted a unique Oval Step Cut Diamond—a rare cut compared to the usual brilliance cut—and Nick made it happen by specially cutting the diamond to my exact specifications. Not only that, but they also ensured it was IGI certified, giving me complete confidence in its quality.

The attention to detail throughout the process was incredible. We worked through several prototypes to perfect the design, and they even provided me with a silver cast spare, which is such a thoughtful touch. The craftsmanship, professionalism, and personalized service truly exceeded my expectations.

If you're looking for a highly skilled and trustworthy jeweler in Saigon, I highly recommend Aurora Saigon. My custom ring is absolutely stunning, and I couldn’t be happier with the entire experience. Five stars all the way!

reviews.fullText:
I am absolutely thrilled with the ring I had custom-made at this jewelry store! From start to finish, the experience was nothing short of exceptional. The staff was incredibly knowledgeable and attentive, helping me design a piece that perfectly matched my vision.

The craftsmanship is beyond impressive—the ring sparkles with such elegance, and the attention to detail is flawless. I am genuinely mesmerized by the beauty of the final product, and I couldn't be happier with how it turned out. It’s clear that this store takes great pride in their work and genuinely cares about their customers. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for something truly special!

reviews.author: zed Bou
reviews.excerpt: Im always very sceptical about parting with money in Vietnam. The quality of information and the trust factor is sadly lacking, but meeting Mrs Aurora was an all round pleaseant shopping experience.
reviews.fullText:
Im always very sceptical about parting with money in Vietnam. The quality of information and the trust factor is sadly lacking, but meeting Mrs Aurora was an all round pleaseant shopping experience. Mrs A is so very personable, and genuinely interested in her clients ideas. It's obvious she's passionate about her business. She has some wonderful pieces, with many gems to choose from, and can upgrade the standard stock, to varying carat gold. I went upscale to 14 carat on a stock amethyst ring design, for my partner. It cost a bit more and had to be made, but it was worth the week wait, and worth every penny!  When I saw the finished piece, it so has the WoW factor. It's absolutely beautiful.
So, many thanks Mrs Aurora, for taking such an interest in the recipient, and what I wanted to achieve. You did us 100% proud, and we had a few laughs on the way! Thank you, you're a gem. You should be in the window 😄

reviews.author: jean casagrande
reviews.excerpt: I can't thank Thuỳ and Nick enough for the work they did for the engagement ring I asked them. Nick helped me from day one with design ideas and suggestions to match as well as possible with my taste and girlfriend's hand type.
reviews.fullText:
I can't thank Thuỳ and Nick enough for the work they did for the engagement ring I asked them.

Nick helped me from day one with design ideas and suggestions to match as well as possible with my taste and girlfriend's hand type. And Thuỳ graphic skills helped me visualize what the end result would look like.
The ring they made met every requirements I had and more.
Nick also obliged with the last minutes changes I asked in the design and the result turned out amazing.

Thuỳ and Nick also made sure that every side stones and the gold were tested and certified  as well, and that the make of the ring was perfect.

In their process they also cast a silver ring to make sure that you're happy with the design before casting the actual ring which I think is great, and you get to keep the silver ring as well.

It was an amazing experience working with them all around and I would highly recommend them.

Worth every penny and more in my opinion.

Thank you Thuỳ and Nick!

reviews.fullText: It was a dream to work with Nick to make our engagement ring. The entire process was very detailed and speedy - I was back home visiting only for two weeks and he had the ring already mocked up for me. All I had to do was give him my stone and he flew to Thailand to have it set in platinum like I wanted. He was such a pleasure to work with and we will be making Aurora our family jeweler going forward. We’re already designing our first anniversary present!

reviews.fullText: I am very glad that I could find Aurora to design and produce our engagement ring. At the end the ring was beautiful! Highly recommended!
